_.what: Back-fill payload for the ACF `closing` group (field_vs_page_closing): consult_eyebrow, consult_headline, consult_body, note — one entry per route, keyed by route.
_.source: Extracted 2026-09-07 from the JSX fallbacks in vivid-smiles-website/src/pages/**/*.astro (the `closing.consultX ? ... : <>fallback</>` branches). JSX whitespace collapsed to single spaces.
_.measured: All 70 values checked against the built dist/: 45 byte-exact, 25 identical after whitespace normalisation (Astro bakes JSX source indentation into the HTML), 0 differing in a word. Writing them therefore changes bytes on ~20 routes but no words.
_.why_left: consult_body and note render as plain text (no set:html); these seven carry an inline <a> or a {phoneLabel} expression, so a stored value would show markup. Absent key = deliberately blank = template fallback keeps rendering.
